page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at 2.7 GHz. This instance features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance, and no hardware GPU accelerators are present.

With its high core count and 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is designed for compute-heavy workloads that require substantial parallel processing power without massive memory footprints. Qualitative cost efficiency is driven by the high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores, making it suitable for large-scale batch processing, high-performance computing simulations, video encoding, and compute-intensive web serving architectures.
